# The Tool Sommelier

> The right AI tool, perfectly paired to your job. Independent comparisons of AI software (voice, video, meetings, writing), organized by the job you need done.

## Guides
- [The best AI voice generators, paired to your project](https://toolsommelier.com/best-ai-voice-generators.html): ElevenLabs, Murf AI, Descript and Speechify compared: which AI voice generator fits voiceovers, podcasts, e-learning or listening to documents.
- [The best AI video generators, paired to the video you need](https://toolsommelier.com/best-ai-video-generators.html): Synthesia, HeyGen, Runway and Descript compared: the right AI video tool for avatar videos, translation, creative clips or editing your own footage.
- [Synthesia vs HeyGen: which AI avatar tool should you pick?](https://toolsommelier.com/synthesia-vs-heygen.html): Synthesia vs HeyGen compared on avatars, languages, translation, ease of use and target users, to help you pick the right AI avatar video tool.
- [The best AI meeting note takers, paired to how you meet](https://toolsommelier.com/best-ai-meeting-note-takers.html): Otter.ai, Fireflies.ai, Fathom and tl;dv compared: the best AI note taker for Zoom, Google Meet and Teams, from free plans to sales teams.
- [The best AI writing tools for marketing, paired to your team](https://toolsommelier.com/best-ai-writing-tools.html): Jasper, Copy.ai, Writesonic and Grammarly compared: which AI writing tool fits marketing teams, SEO content, sales workflows or everyday writing.
